hooks: I want something modern, but classic
Your business partner has opinions too?
This is how websites never get finished

mensajes.texto: For the website I want something modern
Lots of text or a little?
A little. But with all the info
And when do you need it?

contenido.remate: And that's how we've gone two years without a website

captions: When you have to imagine the website, nobody agrees. When you see it built, with your colors and your photos, deciding gets way easier.
Modern but classic, subtle but eye-catching, not much text but all the info. If you've ever said something like that, you're not the only one.
When every partner pictures a different website, the website never happens. With an actual demo everyone can look at, the argument gets unstuck.
